integrity: Nine self-contained UTF-8 artifacts including two independently constructed programming implementations; exact finite-scope verification and all-order mathematical proof are given. Hashes and byte counts reside in the private distribution envelope.
scientific_limitations: The all-order criterion assumes finite simple graphs with minimum degree at least two; finite cycle enumeration, labelled optimizer census and reconfiguration results concern the fifteen-vertex Petersen line graph. title: An edge-endpoint forest criterion and the complete power-domination landscape of the Petersen line graph
